name: amateur-radio
description: By Stefan Brunner, AE5VG. Operate an amateur radio station with Claude: fldigi for PSK, RTTY and the other digital modes, WSJT-X for FT8, FT4 and the weak-signal modes, and N3FJP for logging contacts and contests such as Field Day. Receive-only until you set your callsign.

interface.longDescription:
By Stefan Brunner, AE5VG. Operate an amateur radio station with Claude: fldigi for PSK, RTTY and the other digital modes, WSJT-X for FT8, FT4 and the weak-signal modes, and N3FJP for logging contacts and contests such as Field Day. Receive-only until you set your callsign.

The servers run on your own computer, next to fldigi, WSJT-X and N3FJP, so the plugin needs the ChatGPT desktop app. In ChatGPT no callsign is set, so the station stays receive-only.
defaultPrompt: What is on 20 meters right now?
Find a PSK31 station calling CQ and tune to it
